name: max-skills
description: Agent skills for pull requests (screenshots, demo videos and summaries, straight into the PR description), for product showcase videos, and for starting new projects.

plugins.name: max-skills
plugins.description: pr-screenshots, pr-video and pr-summary capture and summarize what a PR does; showcase-demo makes a launch-style video of the product; new-project takes an idea to a researched PRD and a scaffolded monorepo.
